answer.reason: The story verses tell of Terah's family settling at Haran, Abram leaving it at the LORD's word, and Jacob fleeing there to Laban.

clauses.english: was where Terah's family stopped and dwelt on the way to Canaan
clauses.quote: they came unto Haran, and dwelt there

clauses.english: was where Abram departed from at the LORD's word, with Lot
clauses.quote: So Abram departed, as the LORD had spoken unto him

clauses.english: was where Jacob fled to Laban to escape Esau's anger
clauses.quote: flee thou to Laban my brother to Haran

doubts: 2KI 19:12, ISA 37:12 and EZK 27:23 only name Haran among conquered cities or trading peoples, so they were left out.
ACT 7:2-4 repeat the Genesis account under the spelling Charran, so they were not cited separately.
GEN 11:29 names Haran the man, not the place, and is context only.
